hints.content:
For the $x$ pattern, we add $20$ more to each row.

For the $y$ pattern, we subtract $20$ from each row.

Pattern $x$: Add $\goldE{20}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{19}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{19} + \goldE{20}=\maroonE{39}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{39} + \goldE{20}=\purpleD{59}\end{align}$

Pattern $y$: Subtract $\tealE{20}$

$\begin{align}\text{Starting term}&: \blueE{55}\\\\
\text{Term 2}&:\blueE{55} - \tealE{20}=\maroonE{35}\\\\
\text{Term 3}&:\maroonE{35} - \tealE{20}=\purpleD{15}\end{align}$

Our table of values should look like this:

$x$ | $y$ 
- | - | -
$19$ | $55$ 
$39$ | $35$ 
$59$ | $15$
